declared.title: Lottery winners and accident victims: Is happiness relative?
declared.foundIn: OpenAlex search « lottery winners and accident victims is happiness relative » (2026-11-22); cited by Manson, « How to Be Happy » (2017)

population: Illinois, USA: 22 major lottery winners, 22 controls and 29 paralyzed accident victims (study 1)

findings.text: Major lottery winners were not happier than controls, and took less pleasure in ordinary events

support.sentence: As predicted, lottery winners were not happier than controls and took significantly less pleasure from a series of mundane events.

limits: 22 winners: far too small to detect a moderate difference
one interview, no measure before the win: a comparison of groups, not a follow-up
the classic study behind « lottery winners are not happier », contradicted by larger, later lottery studies (Lindqvist 2020)
